newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot propane mixed late, EIAs awaited.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot propane mixed late, EIAs awaited.

text.p: Spot propane prices dipped in the U.S. Gulf Coast in line with NYMEX crude oil futures, but edged up in the Midwest in quiet activity, players said.
Most players were on the sidelines in afternoon dealings ahead of the weekly Energy Information Administration report on propane inventories due out later today.
Few traders said they were expecting a build in stocks, and added that the numbers were likely to bullish.
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas, spot propane edged down a quarter cent to between 54.25 cents and 54.75 cents a gallon.
The market softened under NYMEX December crude oil futures, which ended down 67 cents at $24.86 a barrel.
In the Midwest, spot propane was assessed 0.25 cent higher at 54.00/54.25 cents.
"It's very quiet. People are just waiting to see what the EIA has to say," said one Midwest player.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
